correctness.rationale: The five generators force at least one coordinate zero; two vanishing coordinates force a coordinate vertex. At one-zero strata, the product quartic eliminates the missing coordinate and two unit-multiple equations force independent cube-root relations. At each coordinate vertex three generators form a regular system of parameters. These local rings coincide with four explicit mu_3^2 components and four sections. Proper/quasi-finite yields finite, and fiberwise Nakayama against the finite-flat closed subscheme proves equality over Z. At p=3 each mu_3^2 has local algebra k[s,t]/(s^3,t^3), length 9 and Hilbert function (1,2,3,2,1), so the total length is 40. For p!=3 cubic roots are separable. The finite-field checker passed at eight primes but is not used as proof.

value.rationale: The arithmetic degeneration of a natural exceptional rank-four complex reflection point configuration is a mathematically motivated scheme-theoretic question. The new exact integral decomposition, preservation of finite flat rank 40 and four noncurvilinear length-nine bad-reduction points explain a genuine degeneration rather than routine count of already known complex points. It supplies a concrete reference model for modular incidence and symbolic-power investigations, without claiming a downstream theorem.
